FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after by the Artificial Limbs, Rehabilitation Appliances and Equipment for the Committee had been approved by the Medical Equipment and HospitaI Council. the draft finalized Disabled Sectional Planning Division

Braille duplicating machine makes use of the technique of vacuum thermoforming for duplicating the masters of braille text including graphs, maps, diagrams, etc, using braille duplicating sheet. In the preparation of this standard, assistance 02 `Braille duplicating machine-Specification', Delhi. has been derived from the Publication IITD RDS issued by the Indian Institute of Technology,

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)`. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. c

FIG. I 6.4 Perforated Sheet

BRAILLE DUPLICATING MACHINE perforated sheet and the shape shall be such that the master copy and the duplicating sheet can be positioned and kept pressed between the frame and the perforated sheet without any leakage. 6.6 Heating System

A perforated sheet with position guide shall be placed over the base plate. The sheet shall have perforation of 2 mm diameter each with a maximum separation of 4 mm in any direction. The size of the sheet shall be determined by the size of the duplicating sheet. 6.5 Gaskets

The machine shall be provided with two jointless, one piece gaskets durable enough to withstand the working temperature over a long period without any appreciable change in hardfin, n*clret "AlUll rhlrl hP m-n,r;Ad tn ness. 6.6.1 The heater lid holds the heater, reflector and insulation ( glass wool and an asbestos separator ). `The lid shall be provided with a plastic knob for rotating the heater assembly back and forth and enough support to avoid sagging. It should act as protective guard for the heater. 6.6.2 The rotation assembly shall be fixed to the base plate to facilitate the movement of the heater lid.

IS 13837 : 1993 6.6.3 The heater shall be operated on single phase 230 V, 5,O Hz AC supply. The rating of the heater shall be 2 kW with safety requirements in accordance with IS 369 : 1983. The heating shall be controlled electronically and shall be variable from lowest to the maximum rating of the heater. 6.6.4 For convenience of fixing, rod type heating elements shall be used. Generally, three or four elements with total capacity of 2 kW, should be used in parallel in order to have uniform heating throughout. A clearance of 30 L *z ~~ _, _,I 1 to 92 mm snail oe piovlded between the peiforated sheet and the heater elements to avoid damage to the sheet. 6.6.5 The reflector shall above the heating element. 6.7 Vacuum System 6.7.1 The vacuum shall be created by a vacuum pump, assembled inside the main body and operated on single phase 230 V, 50 Hz AC electric motor of rating 0.18 kW conforming to IS 996 : 1979. 6.7.2 The minimum vacuum created 0.05 mm of mercury at a displacement of 30 litres per minute. The counter shall indicate correct reading each time. 8.3 Performance of Heat Controller of the master right in the middle of the top end of the frame. Bring the heater over the base plate and note the temperature. Carry out such measurements at eight different positions of the sheet. Repeat this testing at three settings of the heat control knob. The temperature shall not vary from its mean value by more than 5�C for each setting. 9 MARKHNG 9.1 Each braille duplicating marked with the following: a) Indication b) Model c) Country No., of manufacture, and sheet to be used. of the source machine shell be

Connect the two ends of the heating element to multimeter and check the voltage variation while rotating the heat controlling knob. Repeat this operation 30 times. The increase and decrease in voltage with bidirectional rotation of the knob shall be linear over the entire range each time. 8.4 Heater Soaking Keep the heater continuously `ON' for at least 12 hours at its full capacity. Repeat this 5 times after an interval of 24 hours each. The heater shall not show any damage, sagging, short circuiting, cracks or dust particle shedding from its body. 8.5 Test for IJnjform Heating Place a master copy over the and then place a thermocouple perforated sheet over the surface

Standard Mark

The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark ~011 products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously cheked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained fromthe Bureau of Indian Standards.

Bareau of Indiaa Standards

BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 to promote harmonious development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods and attending to connected matters in the country.
